freezePolicy: Only reviewed rows may close as Documented boundary; all other gate failures are blockers.

rows.statement: The GM/Player role picker is a trusted-table convenience, not public authentication.
Rotom Table 1.0 supports one private Linux x86-64 VPS per campaign group, behind an outer access gate.
Browser certification covers the Playwright Desktop Chrome and Pixel 7 Chromium projects only.
Supplement and expansion content packs are post-1.0 and require separately reviewed app-owned canonical data.
Local hosting is deprecated; supported play uses a production Nitro build.
Database downgrade is unsupported; rollback means restoring the exact pre-upgrade backup.
